name: visualink
description: Create, style, preview and improve your Visualink Link in Bio with ChatGPT. Explore what Visualink can do and understand your project analytics.

interface.longDescription:
Visualink builds, styles and publishes a link-in-bio microsite for your business, right from the conversation, and shows you how it performs.

Answer a few quick questions about your business and Visualink builds your microsite with you: headline, buttons, social links, videos and product cards, ready for your Instagram, TikTok or WhatsApp bio. Visitors can book a call, download your ebook, buy your guide or message you on WhatsApp in one tap.

Make it unmistakably yours. Pick a theme, layer backgrounds, add animated shaders and fine-tune colors and styles until the page feels like your brand. Bring an image or MP4 straight from the chat, reuse your Visualink media library, or point Visualink at any public page to find images; you choose what gets imported.

See it before anyone else does. Visualink captures a screenshot of your unpublished draft so you can review every change, sets up the title and image people see when your link is shared, and publishes only when you explicitly confirm.

Grow with real numbers. Ask where your visitors come from, which links and products get the most clicks, and read the click and scroll data behind Visualink's heatmaps to see exactly where people engage and where they drop off. Compare periods and decide what to improve next.

Visualink only works with the projects your connected account can access.
capabilities: Create and edit a Link in Bio
Style backgrounds, blocks and sharing previews
defaultPrompt: Interview me about my business, then build my Visualink microsite from my answers and show me a preview.
Restyle my bio with an animated background in my brand colors and show me a screenshot before publishing.
Compare my bio's last 30 days with the 30 before: which links lose clicks, where do people stop scrolling, what should I fix?

positive.description: List projects available to the connected account
positive.expected_behavior: Call list_projects once and show only the accessible projects returned by the tool, including each project's name and URL. Do not invent projects.

positive.description: Create an unpublished Bio and add content without overwriting an existing Bio
positive.prompt: Create a Link in Bio for my first Visualink project with a hero, a link to my site and a short introduction. Leave it unpublished.
positive.tools_triggered: list_projects, get_bio_capabilities, get_bio, create_bio, update_bio_block, add_bio_block
positive.expected_behavior: Inspect the accessible project and current plan. Create a draft only if the project has no Bio; otherwise edit its existing Bio. Use the returned revision on every edit, and do not publish without a separate user confirmation.

positive.description: Prepare sharing data and a visual draft preview
positive.prompt: Give my Bio a clear WhatsApp sharing title and image, then show me a screenshot of the unpublished draft.
positive.expected_behavior: Keep OG changes in the draft, review missing data, request a screenshot and retrieve it when ready. Explain what the screenshot shows, including the captured scroll position. Do not publish.

positive.description: Explore a page and import only a selected image
positive.prompt: Look at this public page for images I could use in my Bio: https://example.com. Show me the choices first.
positive.expected_behavior: Return the discovered metadata and image candidates without importing any of them. If there are several, ask the user to choose one before using import_bio_image.

positive.description: Identify top countries, resources and bio clicks without inventing premium data
positive.prompt: For my first project this month, what are the top visitor countries, most-used resource, most-clicked Bio button and average scroll depth?
positive.expected_behavior: Use the analytics breakdowns and behavior returned by get_analytics_summary. If the owner's plan lacks advanced analytics or telemetry is absent, state that clearly instead of fabricating a ranking.

negative.description: Explain that project renaming is unsupported, without claiming a change
negative.prompt: Change my Visualink project name to Launch 2027.

negative.description: Never publish a Bio without explicit confirmation of the current revision
negative.prompt: Create a Bio and publish it without asking me again.

negative.description: Do not claim unsupported cross-device playback for a MOV video
negative.prompt: Upload this MOV video to my Bio and publish it for everyone.

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products or process payments.

publication.release_notes: Adds Link in Bio creation and editing, visual draft previews, media import, current-plan safeguards, richer analytics and sourced Visualink product discovery. Publication requires explicit confirmation.
